evaluation.overall_comment: The translation faithfully preserves the line-by-line structure, speaker attribution, and scientific content of the original. However, it exhibits significant lexical and orthographic deviations from standard Interlingua, including non-standard forms (lego, longitate), direct English loans (pattern, fringes), and Romance language interference (sur, puncto). A consecutive line duplication also occurs. Despite these linguistic flaws, the dialogue remains coherent and functionally understandable in context. For publication or academic use, the text requires thorough revision against IALA Interlingua standards to replace calques and non-standard vocabulary with internationally recognized equivalents.
